question: How many prizes were presented at the National Sports and Adventure Awards 2022 held on November 30,2022 , at Rashtrapati Bhawan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**44**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **National Sports and Adventure Awards:-**

 
 
• They are presented annually by the President of India to recognize the achievements of athletes, coaches, and institutions in various sports disciplines.
 
• The awards were instituted in 1985 and are named after some of India's most legendary sportspersons, including Dhyan Chand, Arjuna, and Major Dhyan Chand.
 
• The awards are given to individuals and institutions who have made outstanding contributions to the development and promotion of sports in India. 
 
 
 
• **National Sports and Adventure Awards 2022:-**
 
 
• These were held on November 30, 2022, at Rashtrapati Bhawan in New Delhi, India.
 
• **A total of 44 prizes were presented to athletes, coaches, and institutions for their outstanding contributions to sports. (Hence option 2 is correct)**
 
• The following awards were presented:
 
 
• Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award (1)
 
• Arjuna Award (25)
 
• Dronacharya Award (5)
 
• Dhyan Chand Award (3)
 
• Rashtriya Khel Protsahan Puruskar (5)
 
• Maulana Abul Kalam Azad Trophy (1)
 
• Tenzing Norgay National Adventure Award (12)
